stories.title: USA-Newsblog: Kennedy Center wird laut Trump umgehend geschlossen

en.title: USA News Blog: Kennedy Center to be closed immediately according to Trump
en.summary: The US President sought to place his name on the famous cultural center in Washington, but courts have blocked this action multiple times. He is now attempting to shut down the facility for an extended period.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran: Vorgruppen verlassen Tour von Ed Sheeran nach Rauswurf von Macklemore

en.title: Ed Sheeran: Opening acts leave Ed Sheeran tour after Macklemore's removal
en.summary: Macklemore was removed as an opening act from Ed Sheeran's tour due to pro-Palestinian statements. In solidarity, all other acts have subsequently withdrawn from the tour.

stories.title: Kennedy Center: Von Donald Trump eingesetzte Führung beschließt Schließung

en.title: Kennedy Center: Leadership appointed by Donald Trump decides on closure
en.summary: The renowned Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. is set to close immediately, citing necessary renovation work. Trump previously wanted to have his name displayed at the venue.

stories.title: Kulturzentrum in Washington: Trump droht mit Aus für das Kennedy Center

en.title: Cultural Center in Washington: Trump threatens to end Kennedy Center
en.summary: The Kennedy Center has decided on immediate closure for renovations. A federal judge again prohibited placing Trump's name on the building's facade. Trump is now threatening to eliminate the cultural center.

stories.title: Kennedy Center in Washington D.C.: Donald Trump ordnet sofortige Schließung des Kennedy Centers an

en.title: Kennedy Center in Washington D.C.: Donald Trump orders immediate closure of Kennedy Center
en.summary: Donald Trump has ordered the closure of the Kennedy Center national cultural institution in Washington D.C. A court had previously prohibited Trump from placing his name on the building's facade.

stories.title: Bundeskanzler Merz sagt Reise zur UN-Generaldebatte ab

en.title: Chancellor Merz cancels trip to UN General Debate
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz is canceling his planned attendance at the United Nations General Assembly next week due to domestic political pressures and upcoming state elections in Saxony-Anhalt.

stories.title: Newsblog zur Bundespolitik: Bericht: Merz sagt Reise zur UN-Vollversammlung ab

en.title: News blog on federal politics: Report: Merz cancels trip to UN General Assembly
en.summary: Chancellor Merz will not travel to the UN General Assembly next week due to domestic political discussions and state elections scheduled for the weekend. His presence in Berlin is considered necessary.

stories.title: Friedrich Merz sagt Reise zur Uno-Generaldebatte nach New York ab

en.title: Friedrich Merz cancels trip to UN General Debate in New York
en.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz is canceling his planned trip to the UN General Assembly in the United States next week to address domestic political matters in Berlin following parliamentary elections.

stories.title: Bekannt aus "Das Boot": Schauspieler Ralf Richter ist tot

en.title: Known from "Das Boot": Actor Ralf Richter is dead
en.summary: Actor Ralf Richter, known for his role in the film "Das Boot", has died. He frequently portrayed distinctive characters from the Ruhr region.

stories.title: Film: Schauspieler Ralf Richter ist tot

en.title: Film: Actor Ralf Richter is dead
en.summary: German actor Ralf Richter, known for roles including the film Das Boot, has died at age 69.

stories.title: Ralf Richter ist tot: Schauspieler aus »Das Boot« und »Bang Boom Bang« gestorben

en.title: Ralf Richter is dead: Actor from Das Boot and Bang Boom Bang dies
en.summary: Actor Ralf Richter, best known for his role as Zentralemaat Frenssen in Das Boot, has passed away at age 69.

stories.title: Gasversorgung: Reiche vollzieht Kehrtwende – Staatlicher Gasimporteur Sefe befüllt Gasspeicher

en.title: Gas Supply: Reiche Reverses Course – State Gas Importer Sefe Fills Gas Storage
en.summary: Germany's economy minister has directed the state-owned gas importer Sefe to purchase gas and fill storage facilities to prevent a potential supply crisis. The energy sector has responded positively to the measure.

stories.title: Verteidigung: Pistorius trifft Hegseth in Washington – diesmal gab es für Deutschland sogar Lob von den USA

en.title: Defense: Pistorius meets Hegseth in Washington – this time Germany even received praise from the USA
en.summary: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius and US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth agreed to increase defense cooperation during a meeting in Washington. The discussion was characterized as relaxed.

stories.title: Wall Street: US‑Börsen schließen vor Zinsentscheid einheitlich im Minus

en.title: Wall Street: US exchanges close uniformly lower ahead of interest rate decision
en.summary: Major Wall Street indices declined on Tuesday, continuing the previous day's downward trend. Government bond yields moved higher.
